### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/client`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **45** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **6** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/api.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**16** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 37184244b82b9e4234581b653cdc7554e74e6136`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **6** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/api.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `responseSchema (6 routes)`
- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **213** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **153** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **153**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **98** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **177** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 37184244b82b9e4234581b653cdc7554e74e6136` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `7ee2d8b7d62f6f0dc1b69ab53341f7cd0522d7d0` — the merge of head `108a8625b5610a2e98bb3d15b47481bbb1b7d84f` into base `37184244b82b9e4234581b653cdc7554e74e6136`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 7ee2d8b7d62f6f0dc1b69ab53341f7cd0522d7d0 && git checkout 7ee2d8b7d62f6f0dc1b69ab53341f7cd0522d7d0
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 37184244b82b9e4234581b653cdc7554e74e6136 108a8625b5610a2e98bb3d15b47481bbb1b7d84f && git checkout -B drift-repro 37184244b82b9e4234581b653cdc7554e74e6136 && git merge --no-ff 108a8625b5610a2e98bb3d15b47481bbb1b7d84f

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 37184244b82b9e4234581b653cdc7554e74e6136
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 37184244b82b9e4234581b653cdc7554e74e6136` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `33590a408e75cead7e14e9d4ddcd7cdf38fcea97`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts + packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-customization-package.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts (duplicatePackage and the new ensureCustomizationPackage method), packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts (POST /packages and the new ensure-customization door), the declared narrowing read across those three; cited and read, not reviewed: packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts (N-08, on main), packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-writability.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-ensure-customization.test.ts, packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts, packages/client/src/index.ts, .changeset/28407-customization-pair-ensure-door.md

Inputs: card #28407 body and every comment (triage 6550829258, claim 6552182806 and its two amendments, os-dev-report 6553214307), PR #28512 body and file list, the net diff of the head against merge-base `ea74ebf93f` on origin/main, and the check-runs on the head. The rest of the diff (docs, generated baselines, sweep tests, SDK, ledger row, mount) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT.

### ① Derived judgments

- Public surface, `@objectstack/spec/api`: two new schemas (`EnsureCustomizationPackageRequestSchema`, strict, one key; `EnsureCustomizationPackageResponseSchema`, six required members) and their four type aliases. The five generated baselines move by exactly that: api-surface +6 names, authorable-surface +7 keys, declaration-map +4, export-origins +6, json-schema manifest +2. No existing shape in the file moves; the file-header docblock gains one sentence. RIGHT.
- Public surface, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: a new class method `ensureCustomizationPackage` (body in the new module, protocol.ts split pattern) and a new index export `customizationPairManifestRefusal`, needed so the runtime's no-protocol fallback arm asks the same predicate rather than a copy. RIGHT.
- Public surface, `@objectstack/runtime`: route `POST /packages/:id/ensure-customization`, mounted in dispatcher-plugin.ts, one ledger row (`disposition: sdk`, response schema named, no requestSchema since the door reads no body), census 113 to 114. `PackagesDomainProtocol` gains an optional member typed off the class. RIGHT.
- Public surface, `@objectstack/client`: `packages.ensureCustomization(id)` POSTs with no body to the encoded path. RIGHT.
- Accept-set narrowing (declared): `POST /packages` (both arms, asked after the 409 and the writable gate, before either install limb), the `installPackage` primitive (asked after the whole-manifest parse and before the id-derived namespace default, so the author's own `namespace` is judged), and `duplicatePackage` (asked on a proxy record `{ id: target, namespace: targetNs, dependencies: source.dependencies }`, which is exactly what `dupManifest` later carries: spread of the source manifest with id, name and namespace replaced). A pair-shaped id now installs only with the explicit pair namespace (the exact one when the base is installed) and a dependency entry on the base. RIGHT, and it is the card's Wanted 6.
- OpenAPI: nothing committed to regenerate; `packages/spec/scripts/build-openapi.ts` emits nine fixed contract schemas and no `paths`. RIGHT.
- Unknown-key strictness ledger count 464 to 466 (two new strictness sites). Generated; RIGHT.
- Consequence of N-08's ruled id rule: any id ending in `.custom` whose prefix is a valid non-pair id is a pair (`com.acme.custom` pairs `com.acme`). Measured on origin/main: no non-test manifest under packages, examples or apps declares such an id, so nothing shipped is refused by the narrowing today. The rule is N-08's (merged), not this PR's.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/28407-customization-pair-ensure-door.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor; metadata-protocol, runtime, client patch. Both declaration lines present on the PR body and in the changeset body, byte-identical: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: added`, plus one adr-0087 marker (`not-required`, runtime-interface-only, naming `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`).

- `yes (narrowing)` is the one legal spelling for a diff that widens one surface (the new route and schemas) and narrows another (the three install doors), per `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`. The two claim amendments on the card (6552271697, 6552575476) record the move from `yes (widening)` / `to be derived` to this pair. MATCHES the diff.
- Level: AGENTS.md rule 3 says the level follows the kind alone, at least minor on a package the diff moves. The kind is `added` because the authorable-surface baseline of `packages/spec` gains 7 keys; spec minor. The other three packages move no authorable declaration, so patch, and a breaking non-protocol change ships patch with its ADR-0087 disposition stated, which the changeset does. The `Check Changeset` and `PR-body guards` check-runs on this head concluded success. MATCHES.
- One reading named for the seat, no action required: the install-door refusal tightens what a manifest with a pair-shaped id must carry, which could be read as `narrowed` (several kinds, narrowed over added). Either kind yields the same level (minor on spec), the changeset already carries the ADR-0087 marker a breaking change needs, and the refusal makes a rule N-08 already declared in `packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts` real at the door rather than inventing one. `added` is accepted as the gate accepted it.

### ③ Boundary flags

The os-dev-report (6553214307) lists `open_questions: []` and four `out_of_scope_findings`; each answered here.

1. Files outside the literal file surface (dispatcher-plugin.ts mount, route-ledger.ts row, client index.ts and two client tests, four door-family sweep tests, client-sdk.mdx). The claim said stop on breach and explain; the report explains, and every one of them is demanded by Wanted 1 (route ledger, SDK) or by the door-family sweeps the lane requires of every new write door. ANSWERED: accepted as the lane seat's TIER_DEFAULT remainder.
2. `com.acme.custom` judged as the pair of `com.acme` at the install doors. ANSWERED in ①: N-08's ruled rule, no shipped manifest affected on main, not this PR's policy.
3. Prerelease base: `customizationDependencyRange('2.0.0-beta.1')` answers `^2`, and ADR-0141 D2's installed-version reader admits MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH only (`packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake-dependencies.test.ts`, the prerelease case answers null), so the pair's own install answers `422 DEPENDENCY_MISSING` and the route keeps the per-entry facts. The refusal leaves nothing: `assertDeclaredDependencies` runs before the registry write in the primitive. N-08's own docblock on `customizationDependencyRange` records this exact behaviour. ANSWERED: consistent with the spec on main; a worded ensure-door sentence for that case would be a nicety, listed under ④ as should-fix, not owed by the card.
4. Cross-process concurrency falls to the `sys_packages` key; the runtime TS2322 was caught by check-test-typecheck, not a derived gate. ANSWERED: the module header states the in-process scope of the single-flight and the keyed row; accepted. The gate-coverage remark is a tooling observation for the seat, not a finding on this PR.

Dev flags on the claim amendments: `Clause-②` and `Metadata-protocol` both judged in ②.

Escalated for the seat (outside the card's Wanted, no action on this PR):
- `PATCH /packages/:id` edits `dependencies` with no in-use check (ADR-0141 D3's standing disposition), so an administrator can delete a pair's dependency entry; the ensure door then refuses that pair `409` as not adopted, and the pair is stranded until a manifest declaring both is installed over it. Belongs with N-14 (uninstall protection) or a new card.
- Artifact and marketplace installs reach `SchemaRegistry.installPackage` directly and never pass the primitive, so a vendor artifact carrying `BASE.custom` with the id-derived namespace is not judged by the predicate. The card names only `POST /packages` and `/duplicate`; whether the artifact door must ask the same predicate is the epic's to decide.

Gate verdicts at reading time (check-runs on the head): 23 success, 8 skipped, 0 failure, 31 still in progress (Build Core, Test Core 1 to 8, Test UI 1 to 16, Type Check workspace, debt ledger, consumer gates, Type Check UI, Build and E2E UI, Live E2E UI). Concluded and green among those this record leans on: Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint docs and code guards, Lint PM dispatch-gates, Lint scoped tooling self-tests, Spec property liveness, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links. The pending ones are the queue guard's to read; nothing here anticipates them.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts` (the hits file), judged against ADR-0146 D3 as ruled on the epic (Q4 「全部同意」: explicit `BASE_NS_custom`, N-08's helpers the one spelling) and against its first consumer, `protocol-customization-package.ts`.

- Request schema: strict, one key `basePackageId`. The producer parses the request through it (`EnsureCustomizationPackageRequestSchema.safeParse`, refusal `400` naming the path), so the docblock's ENFORCED claim holds, as it does for the file's one precedent, `ImportUnmanagedPackageRequestSchema`. The route builds the request from the path and refuses a body carrying keys, so a caller cannot smuggle a namespace or a range: the docblock's "derived, never requested" is true of the code, not only of the comment. HOLDS.
- Response schema: six required members. Both return sites in `ensurePairOnce` produce exactly these six, no more; `dependencyRange` is the created `^MAJOR` on create and the declared range read back by `declaredRangeOn` on an existing pair; `writable` is `isWritablePackage(engine, pairId)`, the same predicate the read doors serve. The spec test parses a verbatim capture and refuses every one-member deletion; the runtime test parses every door answer through the schema. HOLDS.
- Docblock claims against the code: "every refusal is thrown before anything is written" holds: the 400, 404, 409 and 422 refusals all precede `this.installPackage`, and the primitive's own refusals (dependency check, protocol handshake, registry NAMESPACE_CONFLICT) precede or undo (#21243) its registry write. "Never rewritten, never adopted" holds: an existing pair lacking the namespace or the dependency throws 409 and is returned unchanged otherwise, with the registry row equal before and after in the test.
- Against ADR-0146 D3 and the ruling: id, namespace and range come from `customizationPackageId`, `customizationNamespace`, `customizationDependencyRange` in `@objectstack/spec/kernel`; nothing in this PR re-derives any of them, and the explicit namespace is set on the manifest before `installPackage`'s id-derived default can run (the default runs only when `namespace` is absent). The created record is a scope-less `module` at `0.1.0`, writable by `isWritablePackage`'s own rule. The one creation path claim holds because the three doors that could mint a pair-shaped id now refuse a manifest lacking what this door writes, and the export-and-reinstall path the ADR promises still works (lit control in the test, both arms).

The narrowing (widened scope, judged on the narrowing face): does it take a declared capability away at the consumer, or make the spec's own refusal real? N-08 declared on main that a pair's namespace is `BASE_NS_custom`, never derived, and that a pair depends on its base; `ManifestSchema` cannot express a rule conditional on the id, so the door is where that declared rule becomes real. Before this head, `POST /packages` with `hotcrm.custom` and no namespace stored namespace `custom`, the value the ADR says is never written. The refusal names the key, echoes what the author wrote, and names the door that writes both. Measured on main, no shipped manifest is refused by it. VERDICT on the face: it makes the spec's refusal real; it removes no declared capability.

Attempts to break it, each read in the live tree:
- Two concurrent calls: the flight map is keyed per registry (WeakMap) and per pair id; a waiter awaits every in-flight promise then re-judges the registry in the same turn as it registers its own run, so no second create slips between the check and the set. A waiter whose predecessor's persist failed finds the registry undone (#21243) and creates. Sound.
- `overwrite: true` over an existing pair with a manifest lacking the namespace or dependency: the predicate runs after the writable gate and refuses `400`, so a pair cannot be rewritten into a non-pair through the install door. Sound.
- Duplicate into a pair id with no explicit `targetNamespace`: `deriveNamespaceFromPackageId` answers `custom`, the predicate refuses before any row is read (the test counts zero `find` calls). Sound.
- A base whose namespace is 14 characters, or none: ensure refuses `409` with the N-08 reason; the predicate refuses any exported pair for that base too, since no namespace can be "the pair's". Consistent with no truncation and no hashing.
- A squatter on `BASE_NS_custom`, including one the registry would admit as an ADR-0141 D5 co-owner: refused `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` before the install. Sound.
- Walled postures: the door orders capability, wall, closed query, body, then protocol, as the install door does; the sweep gains the fourteenth door. Sound.

Findings:
- must-fix: none.
- should-fix (wording, low): `customizationPairManifestRefusal`'s sentence for a base installed with no pair namespace ends by prescribing the ensure door, which refuses that same base `409`; the prescription should say the base has no pair rather than point at a door that cannot help. The clause before it already states the reason, so no caller is misled about why.
- should-fix (wording, low): a prerelease base at the ensure door answers ADR-0141 D2's `DEPENDENCY_MISSING` facts, which name the range and the installed version but not that the pair cannot be created until the base is at a release of that major; one sentence in the door's catch would say so. Recorded in N-08's docblock, not owed by the card.
- observation, no fix owed: the install door admits an exported pair for a WRITABLE base (the predicate asks only item 2), while the ensure door refuses that base `409`. Wanted 6 asks the door to refuse a manifest that breaks item 2 and nothing more, so this is per card; the two doors answer differently about one base, which the seat may want N-14 or the epic to look at.

ACCEPT · PR #28512 · Head-sha `33590a408e75cead7e14e9d4ddcd7cdf38fcea97` · 2026-11-01T04:30Z

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 新增 `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/ensure-customization` 与 `client.packages.ensureCustomization`：为已装的只读基础包返回配对定制包 `BASE.custom`，缺则经安装原语创建（命名空间 `BASE_NS_custom`，依赖基础包 `^MAJOR`）。新建回 201，已存在回 200，幂等，同一配对单飞。安装门、安装原语和复制门拒收缺命名空间或缺依赖的配对形 id。
- **为什么改：** ADR-0146 D3 的配对定制包此前没有创建入口；手工安装会从 id 派生出 `custom` 命名空间，也不声明依赖基础包。
- **风险与回滚：** 新路由与两个 schema 是纯新增；收窄只拦缺两项声明的配对形 id，导出的完整配对照常安装，主干上没有已发布清单带 `.custom` id。回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据迁移。
- **先看：** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-customization-package.ts`；`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 的新门鉴权顺序；`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-ensure-customization.test.ts`，35 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

席位意见：at-tier 契约评审 PASS，无必改；两处措辞建议与两条范围外观察记在下面；可合。

## 席位核对

- **Form:** 27 files, +1263/-17. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28512`: NOT governed, 1280 lines ≤ 3000, Tier S. Declaration of record: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` (the route and two schemas widen, and `POST /packages`, `installPackage` and the duplicate target narrow) and `Metadata-protocol: added` (7 authorable-surface keys). spec is minor, the others patch. CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review on the schema face, widened to the narrowing, PASS at this head (6553295429), by an at-tier reviewer the seat fed the `--brief-template` brief. `Skills-docs: none` holds: no skill teaches the `/packages` doors, and the docs half is in this diff.
- **Premise measured:** the door test (35) runs over a real protocol and `SchemaRegistry`. It covers two real concurrent calls (one 201, one 200, one write) and the persist-failure race. Each refusal leaves no package and no write.
- **Gates (check-runs at the pinned head):** 65 runs: 57 success, 8 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending; mergeable, clean. Dev: 108 derived, 108 run, 0 NOT MEASURED. Full build and lint 0. Dogfood on the final head: 2926 passed. 19 ablations went red and each was restored.
- **Accepted deviations:** two should-fix wording points from the review stay as written, not worth a rework round.
  - The no-namespace refusal points at the ensure door, which refuses that base 409.
  - A prerelease base at the ensure door answers ADR-0141 D2 `DEPENDENCY_MISSING` without saying it must be at a release first.
- **Out of scope and where it goes:** three observations from the review, none filed (no reach measured), recorded here for the epic #28236:
  - `PATCH /packages/:id` can delete a pair's `dependencies` entry, which strands the pair at the ensure door. Belongs with N-14 or a new card once measured.
  - Artifact and marketplace installs reach `SchemaRegistry.installPackage` without the primitive's predicate. The card names only `POST /packages` and the duplicate, so this is the epic's call.
  - The install door admits an exported pair for a writable base, while the ensure door refuses that base. This follows card Wanted 6.
- **Landing clause:** Tier S ordinary queue landing. The seat flips ready and enables auto-merge through the relay, then confirms MERGED and closes out #28407.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c85bce56f34bdabdd5582d66536b32c73b35a329`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts + packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-customization-package.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts (duplicatePackage and ensureCustomizationPackage), packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts (POST /packages, the ensure-customization door, and the resolved conflict hunk in PackagesDomainProtocol), the declared narrowing read across those three; cited and read for the delta, not reviewed: packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (assertPackageUninstallable, #28506), packages/metadata-protocol/src/served-override.ts and the served-override read in protocol.ts (#28507), packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-write-actor-session.test.ts (#28502), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-write-package-scope.ts via resolveWritePackageScope

Delta review by the same reviewer. This head is a merge commit of origin/main `eeec88d1` into `claude/project-thread-7yvsri` after the merge queue dropped the PR for MERGE_CONFLICT (#28507, N-10, merged first). Its first parent is the reviewed head `33590a40` (record 6553295429); the new merge-base with origin/main is `eeec88d1` itself.

Measured, read-only:
- `git show --remerge-diff c85bce56`: ONE conflict hunk, in packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts, the `PackagesDomainProtocol` type. The resolution keeps both optional members with their own docblocks, in this order: `ensureCustomizationPackage?` (this PR, typed off the class method) then `getMetaItemsPerPackage?` (#28409 via #28507, typed off the class method). Nothing else in the merge differs from a clean three-way merge.
- The PR's net diff against its merge-base is byte-identical before and after the merge (`git diff ea74ebf9 33590a40` against `git diff eeec88d1 c85bce56`, hunk headers aside) except for that resolution, which adds main's member beside this PR's. Same 27 files, 1263 insertions, 17 deletions.
- Scope files identical between the two heads by blob: package-lifecycle.zod.ts, protocol-customization-package.ts, protocol-package-install.ts, route-ledger.ts, dispatcher-plugin.ts, the changeset, both new tests, authorable-surface/api.json. protocol.ts, metadata-protocol index.ts, client index.ts and packages.ts differ only by what main brought (#28507's served-override read and export layer, #28502's session actor, #28506's uninstall refusal), none of it in this PR's hunks: main's protocol.ts delta touches no line of installPackage, duplicatePackage or updatePackage, and its packages.ts delta touches the type (the conflict) and the five actor-taking doors, not the `POST /packages` branch or the region the ensure door sits in.

### ① Derived judgments

Unchanged from record 6553295429 at 33590a40. Delta: the one new line of public surface at this head is main's `getMetaItemsPerPackage?` member kept beside this PR's in `PackagesDomainProtocol`; it is #28507's, already on main, and the resolution adds and removes nothing of either side. RIGHT.

### ② Semver level
